title: Warehouses
description: Manage the locations that hold your stock.

help.title: About Warehouses
help.overview: A warehouse is a stock location. Inventory rows, stock transfers, stock counts, order holds, and tills all point at warehouses. Name and code are required; the address is optional but decides the VAT of till sales.

sections.title: Default and active
items: Set default makes this warehouse the company default and clears the previous one. Checkout tries the default warehouse first.
Only active warehouses hold stock for checkout and can be assigned to tills.
Deactivating a warehouse that is the only warehouse of a till is refused; otherwise it is removed from tills that still have another warehouse.

sections.title: Deleting
sections.body: Stock cannot vanish with its warehouse.
items: A warehouse whose rows still hold stock or reservations cannot be deleted. Transfer or write the stock off first.
Deleting is a soft delete and it can be restored, unless another live warehouse now uses the same code.

sections.title: Related pages
items: Inventory shows the stock per item in each warehouse; Stock movements shows its history.
The Odoo import can create warehouses from Odoo.
